Within **two hops**, ReportingService needs the following **9 distinct entities**: 5 services, 2 APIs, and 2 databases.

| Hop | From | Relationship | Required entity | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ReportingService | Depends on | **BillingService** | Service |
| 1 | ReportingService | Depends on | **OrderService** | Service |
| 2 | BillingService | Stores data in | **BillingPostgresDatabase** | Database |
| 2 | BillingService | Calls | **NotificationsAPI** | API |
| 2 | BillingService | Calls NotificationsAPI, served by | **NotificationsService** | Service |
| 2 | OrderService | Stores data in | **OrdersPostgresDatabase** | Database |
| 2 | OrderService | Calls | **PaymentsAPI** | API |
| 2 | OrderService | Calls PaymentsAPI, served by | **PaymentsService** | Service |
| 2 | OrderService | Depends on | **UserService** | Service |

The service behind each called API is included at the same dependency level as that API. The dependency query returned no configuration keys.
